acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Elementals family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Elemental Spirit, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Tether-Reach Soldier (Soldier) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Human-sized faceless hovering torso with exactly two tapering arms, one central seed-core, and a legless lower body dissolving into a continuous tail.
Signature mechanic: Tether Reach: one arm channel lengthens across a marked lane while the compact torso and opposite arm hold the binding core in place.
battlefieldDuty: Apply repeatable mid-range pressure with one committed arm channel.
constructionDimensions: Deep-blue cohesive liquid, surface-tension membranes, circulating current lines, droplets, and pressure rings form the complete body around a dense clear core.
Motion pours upward through the flame-like family contour and returns through visible channels, mantle shells, and core facets without becoming ice or shapeless mist.
counterplay: Cross behind the extending tether and strike the exposed side of the core before the arm retracts. Affinity signal: A pressure ring expands and the seed, return channel, drainage shutter, or core facet clears when the committed flow briefly loses pressure.
forbiddenTreatments: Shapeless mist without a liquid circuit
Water pasted over a neutral body
Blue palette without cohesive fluid behavior
identityInvariants: Every form is organized around one readable binding seed or core, with no flesh, worn armor, ordinary clothing, handheld weapon, or fixed face.
The T1 Wisp is a small asymmetric teardrop or flame-like shape without limbs; T2–T5 develop a legless hovering upper body with exactly two coherent arm channels and a tapering lower body.
Affinity substance forms the complete load-bearing body, limbs, mantle, and directional wake rather than appearing as a colored exterior aura or decorative overlay.
Form coherence, core structure, and spatial control progress from one wandering Wisp to a four-facet Sovereign while the active telegraph and exposed counterplay remain readable.
telegraph: The legless upper body narrows, one arm thins into a taut tether, and the core shifts visibly away from it.
